headline_marked: NASA shares [[over 800GB of Artemis II mission data]] including 11,000+ photos and videos
headline: NASA shares over 800GB of Artemis II mission data including 11,000+ photos and videos
summary: Explore the historic Artemis II mission with an unprecedented archive of science data, images, and audio released by NASA.
details: NASA has released a massive archive of over 800GB of data from the Artemis II mission, offering an unprecedented look inside the historic spaceflight. The collection includes more than 11,000 photos and videos, alongside over 8.5 hours of audio recordings.

Among the highlights is footage capturing the Artemis II crew reporting observations of impact flashes on the dark side of the Moon. These flashes, potentially the faintest ever observed by the human eye, generated palpable excitement among the crew and ground teams.

The archive also features crew-annotated images, providing unique insights into the mission's observations. NASA has supplemented this data dump with three key documents: the Artemis II Preliminary Lunar Science Report, the Artemis II Lunar Science Operations Report, and the Artemis II Lunar Science Data User Guide.

This extensive release allows the public and scientific community to delve deeper into the mission's findings and the crew's experiences. The 'Sights & Sounds of Science' website now hosts this treasure trove of information for exploration.

topic: google pixel vs samsung software update longevity
headline_marked: Google Pixels [[get up to 7 years]] of software updates
headline: Google Pixels get up to 7 years of software updates
summary: Google's latest Pixel 8 and future models will receive seven years of OS upgrades and security patches, a significant boost for Android device longevity.
details: Google announced that Pixel phones released from the Pixel 8 onwards will receive a remarkable seven years of software updates. This includes major Android OS upgrades and crucial security patches, extending the device's lifespan significantly.

This commitment surpasses previous Android update promises, including those from Samsung. While older Pixel models (Pixel 6 and 7 families, original Pixel Fold) receive five years of support, and earlier models are now obsolete, the Pixel 8 series sets a new standard.
For example, the Pixel 7 and 7 Pro are slated to receive their final updates by the end of October 2027. The Pixel 6 and 6 Pro are reaching their end of support in October 2026.

The Pixel 8 and 8 Pro, launched in 2023, are guaranteed updates until October 2030. Future models like the Pixel 9 and 9 Pro are expected to follow suit, receiving updates until 2031, and so on, extending support well into the next decade.
While custom ROMs like LineageOS can extend the life of older Pixels, they may not offer the same level of security as official updates, especially for sensitive applications like banking.
